source: COMNAP (2025), Antarctic Facilities Information; current interactive map
license: COMNAP: educational and non-commercial purposes only; see src/rom/sidera-stations-license.txt
scope: Open research stations south of 60 S, year-round or seasonal, with confirmed coordinates, sea-level elevation and civil time zone.
notes: Station-first order; Arctowski is the AQ default.
Coordinates are representative COMNAP facility points, not navigation fixes. Elevations are representative integer metres above sea level; independent sources resolve ambiguous COMNAP datum labels.
Etc/GMT signs follow IANA POSIX notation: Etc/GMT+3 means UTC-3. Fixed zones describe documented operating time, not reconstructed history.
Regional IANA zones follow their own historical tables; these are not proof of station civil time before occupation. Future dates extrapolate the bundled IANA rules.
Troll follows the IANA UTC/UTC+2 approximation; exact historical intermediate UTC+1 dates are not documented in tzdb.
Arctowski elevation is corroborated by the 2026 study of the station sea terrace (2 m a.s.l.).
